## Brief

- Core message: CodeGrind now features enhanced AI-assisted problem solving powered by Azure OpenAI, offering multiple model support, persistent chat, and improved guidance within the LeetCode-style practice environment. This streamlines learning and accelerates debugging directly in the IDE.
- CTA: Try the new AI-assisted problem-solving flow in CodeGrind and share a quick performance highlight from your last solved challenge.
